rawContent: @LeoECasey @NYCSchools There's parts of this I agree with, but having a school district give mixed messages about their stance on the #ClimateStrike gives teachers and students a mixed message on #ClimateChange and affects their comfort with teaching climate change.

@d4v1d5m1t6 @aeo2626 @NPR @realDonaldTrump Yes, and then you'll burn in 8.5 years if nothing is done about the #ClimateCrisis. This is not a tantrum. This is the righteous anger of teenagers who can't dream of a future because of what we've done to the environment. Shame on you for dismissing this as a mere "tantrum."

It's such an important activity for both students and teachers alike to remember WE are nature. To remember our tie to Mother Earth. And then teachers can learn about the Earth, how to fight #climatechange, then help students be citizens, engage in democracy, and be collective.
